name: Patrick Halligan

summary.text: Patrick Halligan was chief financial officer of Archegos Capital Management, the family office of Sung Kook (Bill) Hwang whose March 2021 collapse caused about $10 billion of losses at its prime brokers. In July 2024 a Manhattan federal jury convicted Halligan of securities fraud, wire fraud and racketeering conspiracy alongside Hwang; in January 2025 he was sentenced to eight years in prison and remained free on bail pending appeal. Hwang was sentenced to 18 years in November 2024.
